detail.body:
## Before submitting

- [x] License agreed (LICENSE.txt).
- [x] `pre-commit run` on the changed files (never `--all-files`).
- [x] Hard Rules of every touched directory's AGENTS.md checked; exceptions explained below.
- [ ] Labels: `cat-feature`, `area:sdpa`, `op:sdpa-bwd`, `orig-nv-eng`. Reviewer at open / un-draft.

## Affected area

FE OSS kernels or CuTeDSL (Python API: typed op-level fields on the sm100 d128 backward adapter)

## Summary

A second implementation of the d128 grouped THD BF16 backward (GQA / MQA, top-left causal or unmasked) on SM100: one cluster of two CTAs
owns a 256-row KV work item, each CTA computes its 128-row half with `cta_group::2` MMAs and the dS^T halves are exchanged through DSMEM;
the setup, delta / dQ-zero, dQ-cast and group-fold launches are shared with the one-CTA chain (five launches, the same workspace contract).
A typed per-S heuristic (`cta_pair`) serves the pair body when both declared sequence extents reach 8192 on cc 10.0 and the device admits
a cluster of two, and the one-CTA body otherwise.

## Why

At the sequence lengths where the one-CTA body is MMA-bound and the dS^T exchange can be shared, a pair of CTAs per KV block halves the
redundant operand traffic and the per-CTA SMEM pressure: measured on a GB200-class node the pair body beats the one-CTA body on the backward
step by +4.9 % at 8K, +7.9 % at 16K, +8.5 % at 32K and +8.8 % at 64K (uniform; the varlen ramps +6.5 / +8.3 %; on CUDA-graph replay of the whole
chain +10.8 / +10.5 / +9.6 / +9.0 % at 16K / 32K / 64K / 16K ramp), and loses at 2K / 4K -- hence the per-S rule rather than a replacement.

## Related issues

None

## API and compatibility impact

Append-only, typed op-level fields on `SdpaBwdDslSm100D128` (set on the adapter instance before `check_support()`; every value outside a
domain declines by name; the defaults render the one-CTA chain byte-identically where it is chosen, pinned by PTX md5):
- `cta_pair`: `auto` (default: the rule above) | `off` (the one-CTA body always) | `on` (the pair at any S; a failing predicate -- THD, cc,
  cluster admission, grouped heads -- declines by name).
- `dkv_accum`: `bf16_partials` (default: one bf16 partial per q head plus the fp32 fold launch, a fixed summation order) | `fp32_reduce`
  (opt-in, both grouped THD bodies: fp32 accumulation across the q heads of a kv head in hardware order with one bf16 rounding at the
  output, four launches). This is a rounding change, an op attribute rather than a knob: under `fp32_reduce` dK / dV are not bitwise
  reproducible across runs (dQ is untouched; `use_deterministic_algorithm` is already declined on this route). Declined by name on dense
  GQA, on MHA and under `warp_roles="16w_fa4"`.
- `mask_form`: `fsel` (default) | `predicated` (the mask body only on tiles that can hold a masked cell; bitwise-identical outputs, measured
  neutral) | `diag_mask_off` (diagnostic, output wrong by design).
- `warp_roles`: `16w` (default) | `16w_fa4` (an alternate role shape kept for follow-up work: the softmax writes the dS halves from its
  registers and ships the exchange, warps 8-11 form the reduce group; bitwise-identical dK / dV; measured slower on GB200 at 8K-64K; the
  stamps lever and `fp32_reduce` decline by name under it).
- `diag_2cta` (four default-off diagnostic probes, output wrong by design, refused by a probe driver's `--validate`) and `debug_clk`
  (default-off timing stamps, output correct) for engineering use.
- `diag_delete_dq_reduce_add` (default False): a diagnostic of the one-CTA d128 accumulation bodies that skips the fp32 dQ reduce-add
  issues (output wrong by design; the default renderings of the two THD hosts are pinned by PTX md5).
Capability fields are unchanged (the pair is an implementation variant inside the engine's envelope); the tracker row says NATIVE.
`SUPPORT_MATRIX_TRACKER.md` is updated in the same commit (Rule S2).

## Testing

```
cd test/python && pytest -m L0 -ra sdpa/frost/test_sdpa_bwd_d128_2cta_stail_sm100.py sdpa/frost/test_sdpa_bwd_d128_2cta_stail_xfa4_sm100.py \
    sdpa/frost/test_sdpa_bwd_d128_cta_pair_heuristic.py sdpa/frost/test_sdpa_bwd_d128_dkv_accum_sm100.py \
    sdpa/frost/test_sdpa_bwd_d128_diag_dq_reduce_add_sm100.py sdpa/frost/test_sdpa_bwd_d128_grouped_sm100.py
```
Host tier (x86, no GPU, DSL 4.8.1): stail 19 passed / 34 skipped, xfa4 8 / 23, heuristic 25 / 4, dkv_accum 8 / 21, diag 6 / 0, grouped
(the unchanged base module) 1 / 22; 0 failed. GPU tier (one GB200-class device, cc 10.0, from detached snapshots: the pair-body module's 41 rows on the tree one comment line before
this head, every other row on this head; kernel code identical, PTX md5 4b3d0bbb): pair-body module 41 passed (the 8-cell matrix, all-empty,
pairs > SMs, the zero-trip mix, the launch census, the mask-form bitwise twins, the stamps dump, the four probes) + 10 fresh-process pair-skew
rows passed (incl. the fp32_reduce seam twins and the exchange_off-under-skew child); alternate role shape 19 passed + 3 zero-trip hang-repro
rows passed; heuristic / dkv_accum / base grouped module 73 passed, 1 skipped (the cc-decline row is observable off cc 10.0 only); the 7
pair-skew rows of `warp_roles="16w_fa4"` were re-run from the identical rendering (PTX md5 83dacedc) on a shared cc 10.0 device: 7 of 7 pass, no fault, no hang
(`<main agent fills: xfa4 pair-skew 7 rows: passed / failed>`) -- a queued or skipped row is not a pass.
RED-then-green: the zero-trip hang rows of the alternate role shape fail by watchdog on the pre-fix tree and pass here; the heuristic's
rows were red on the missing symbols; the dkv_accum host rows red before the field. Skips are GPU rows on the host tier only.

## Contract and envelope (append-only)

The seven fields above, at the END of the adapter's field block; every decline by NAME with a typed message (`ValueError` for a value
outside a domain, `NotImplementedError` for a request the body does not serve). Dense GQA, MHA and cc other than 10.0 keep the one-CTA
bodies; cc 10.3 serves the one-CTA body under `auto` and declines `on` by name until a measurement exists there.

## Tests (all L0; RED-first on the pre-change tree)

Host rows: config = truth (every number the kernel header quotes is an asserted config field), typed domains + declines, the PTX md5
records of the default and the `16w_fa4` renderings (byte-identical to the audited ones), the deterministic-hang topologies as source
assertions. GPU rows: the 8-cell THD matrix (S % 256 != 0, empty sequences, a half-dead pair, n_q == 1, non-causal, a varlen ramp),
all-empty, pairs > SMs, the zero-trip mix, the launch census per heuristic selection, the bitwise dK / dV twins between the selectable
forms (mask_form, warp_roles), the fp64 ladder of the fp32_reduce arm on both bodies, the fresh-process pair-skew detectors (one lever per
barrier seam; each row a fresh child under a watchdog, budget `skew_module`) and the zero-trip hang repro rows. The dense suite is untouched
(the two THD hosts' default-rendering md5 records hold; the dense MHA body's default rendering has no md5 record yet -- its default path is
covered by the dense suite's L0 rows).

<!-- disclosure: public -->
## Measured

One GB200-class node (cc 10.0, 152 SMs), SM clock locked at 1830 MHz, exclusive GPU. Every process ran below the lock under the node's
power limit (the sampled busy-median SM clock is printed per row): absolute times are clock-capped LOWER BOUNDS `[LB]`, the ratios inside one
session are the figures of record. Per cell: A/B/A, 3 rounds x 100 iterations, shuffled slots, a control twin (the base timed twice), band =
max(1 %, |control pair|); the FROST process (one-CTA body, pair body, canary) and then the FlashAttention-4 process (own environment) on the same
GPU back-to-back; at every long cell a second process per library with the build order rotated. Speed-ups are `base / new - 1` (positive =
faster). FROST: this PR's kernel (the pair body's default rendering, PTX md5 4b3d0bbb, byte-identical in every tree measured); FlashAttention-4 98c1cee0 (`flash_attn.cute`, varlen backward entry; 7 launches at S >= 4K, 3 on its packed-GQA path at 2K); both
validated against the same fp64 per-sequence oracle in separate runs. Cell: B 4, Hq 32, Hkv 4, d 128, bf16, causal (top-left), THD (packed)
layout; `uniform` = every sequence of length S; `ramp` = per-sequence lengths S/4, S/2, 3S/4, S. FLOP convention: exact causal pairs per
sequence, GQA by Hq. Date 2026-10-27.

### Level 1 -- the in-session eager backward step

| S | lengths | FROST one-CTA step ms [LB] | FROST pair step ms [LB] | FlashAttention-4 step ms [LB] | pair / FAv4 (band) -> bar 1.03 | level 2 (graph replay) | pair vs one-CTA +X % (band) | served by `auto` | MHz (FROST / FAv4 process; capped) | tree (FROST / FAv4) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2K | uniform | 0.466 | 0.485 | 0.632 (packed-GQA path) | 0.767 (1.00) -> PASS | n/a | -3.9 % (1.00) | no: one-CTA body | 1830 / 1830 | earlier tree, same rendering (md5 4b3d0bbb) / 98c1cee0 |
| 4K | uniform | 1.473 / 1.491 | 1.526 / 1.438 | 1.581 / 1.414 | 0.965 (1.00) / 1.017 (2.99) -> inside noise of the bar | n/a | -3.5 % (1.00) / +3.7 % (1.67): split across build orders -> not a win at the step | no: one-CTA body | 1695 / 1725; 1650 / 1747 | earlier tree, same rendering (md5 4b3d0bbb) / 98c1cee0 |
| 4K | ramp | 0.764 / 0.772 | 0.906 / 0.753 | n/q (the FAv4 control pairs read -11.8 / -17.5 %) | n/q at the step | n/a | -15.7 % (1.00) / +2.5 % (1.04): split -> not a win at the step | no: one-CTA body | 1822 / 1830 | earlier tree, same rendering (md5 4b3d0bbb) / 98c1cee0 |
| 8K | uniform | 5.336 | 5.087 | 4.971 | 1.023 (1.00; canary moved +1.9 %) -> inside noise of the bar | n/a | +4.9 % (1.00) | yes: pair | 1545 / 1552 | earlier tree, same rendering (md5 4b3d0bbb) / 98c1cee0 |
| 16K | uniform | 20.070 / 20.021 | 18.595 / 18.571 | 17.934 / 17.922 | 1.037 / 1.036 (1.00 / 1.00) -> inside noise of the bar | 1.032 -> inside noise of the bar | +7.9 % / +7.8 % (1.00 / 1.00) | yes: pair | 1492 / 1492; 1492 / 1492 | this PR's kernel (md5 4b3d0bbb) / 98c1cee0 |
| 32K | uniform | 77.590 / 77.522 | 71.533 / 71.373 | 68.983 / 68.892 | 1.037 / 1.036 (1.00 / 1.00) -> inside noise of the bar | 1.028 -> inside noise of the bar | +8.5 % / +8.6 % (1.00 / 1.00) | yes: pair | 1477 / 1432; 1477 / 1440 | this PR's kernel (md5 4b3d0bbb) / 98c1cee0 |
| 16K | ramp | 9.578 / 9.545 | 8.994 / 9.067 | 8.731 / 8.682 | 1.030 / 1.044 (1.40 / 1.07; canary moved -2.2 % in the rotated pair) -> FAIL (by 0.36 pt in the rotated order) | 1.019 -> PASS | +6.5 % / +5.3 % (1.00 / 1.07) | yes: pair | 1537 / 1530; 1522 / 1530 | this PR's kernel (md5 4b3d0bbb) / 98c1cee0 |
| 32K | ramp | 36.902 / 36.738 | 34.085 / 33.893 | 32.693 / 32.627 | 1.043 / 1.039 (1.00 / 1.00; canary moved -1.3 / +2.0 %) -> FAIL (by 0.26 pt in the forward order) | n/a (no graph-replay row at this cell yet) | +8.3 % / +8.4 % (1.00 / 1.00) | yes: pair | 1492 / 1455; 1492 / 1462 | this PR's kernel (md5 4b3d0bbb) / 98c1cee0 |
| 64K | uniform | 304.211 / 303.945 | 279.708 / 279.367 | 268.851 / 268.487 | 1.040 / 1.041 (1.00 / 1.00; canary moved +2.2 / +4.9 %) -> FAIL (by 0.04 / 0.05 pt) | 1.032 -> inside noise of the bar | +8.8 % / +8.8 % (1.00 / 1.00) | yes: pair | 1485 / 1425; 1485 / 1425 | this PR's kernel (md5 4b3d0bbb) / 98c1cee0 |

Two values in a cell are the forward / rotated build-order twins. `pair / FAv4` = pair step / FlashAttention-4 step (< 1 = FROST faster); bar
1.03: PASS when (ratio - 1) + band <= 3 % in both build orders, FAIL when (ratio - 1) - band > 3 % in either, else inside noise of the bar;
a split pair is read at its worse value. `pair vs one-CTA` = one-CTA step / pair step - 1. "canary moved" = an unchanged GEMM timed in both
processes moved by more than the band between them (the two processes sat in different clock states): the ratio is reported as measured, never
normalised. The 2K / 4K / 8K rows were measured on an earlier tree whose pair-body default rendering is byte-identical (PTX md5 4b3d0bbb) to
the rows of record; the host-side selector was not yet in that tree, so the `served by auto` column names the body the shipped rule selects.
At 4K the eager step sits below the protocol's resolution (one slot per round reads +15-27 % in either library); the per-launch device sums of
the same processes read the pair +2.4 % faster at 4K uniform and equal at the 4K ramp, and the FROST chain at or ahead of FlashAttention-4's
THD path at both.

### Level 2 -- CUDA-graph replay of the whole backward chain per library

| S | lengths | FROST one-CTA replay ms [LB] @ MHz | FROST pair replay ms [LB] @ MHz | FlashAttention-4 replay ms [LB] @ MHz | pair vs one-CTA +X % (replay; band) | pair / FAv4 (replay) -> bar 1.03 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 16K | uniform | 20.852 @ 1447 | 18.822 @ 1447 | 18.232 @ 1470 | +10.8 % (1.00) | 1.032 -> inside noise of the bar |
| 32K | uniform | 79.184 @ 1425 | 71.659 @ 1454.5 | 69.675 @ 1410 | +10.5 % (1.00) | 1.029 -> inside noise of the bar |
| 64K | uniform | 309.645 @ 1470 | 282.493 @ 1410 | 273.665 @ 1387 | +9.6 % (1.00) | 1.032 -> inside noise of the bar |
| 16K | ramp | 9.768 @ 1515 | 8.965 @ 1503.5 | 8.801 @ 1500 | +9.0 % (1.00) | 1.019 -> PASS |

Per cell one FROST session (one-CTA body, pair body, a control twin = the pair body captured twice, an unchanged GEMM canary) and then one
FlashAttention-4 session (its backward, its control twin, the same canary) on the same GPU: warm-up, capture (the captured kernel list equals
the eager list in every arm), 10 profiled replays, then 100 event-timed replays per arm shuffled across the arms of the session, the SM clock
sampled after every replay; the row quotes the median replay at the median sampled clock. The twin pairs on the replay were 0.00-0.79 % (band
1 %); the canary moved <= 1.0 % between the two sessions of every cell. The pair-vs-one-CTA ratio inside one session is the figure of that
column; the pair / FAv4 ratio spans two sessions at different sampled clocks, so the ms ratio is the figure (the sampled clocks stand in the cells). Replays are L2-warm; the graph-launch gap (event wall minus the kernel span of the same replays) was 19-24 us in every arm.

### Reading

The pair body beats the shipping one-CTA body on the backward step at every cell from 8K up, +4.9 % at 8K, +7.9 / +7.8 % at 16K, +8.5 / +8.6 %
at 32K, +8.8 % at 64K and +5.3..+8.4 % on the varlen ramps, in both build orders and beyond the band; on the graph replay the margin is
+9.0..+10.8 %. Below 8K the pair loses or splits at the step (2K -3.9 %; 4K split across build orders with the kernel chains equal or 2.4 %
in the pair's favour), which is why the per-S rule serves the one-CTA body there and the pair from 8K up. Against FlashAttention-4 the pair
body's eager step reads 1.036-1.044 at 16K-64K: inside the noise of the 1.03 bar at the two 16K / 32K uniform cells in both build orders,
and failing it by 0.04-0.36 pt at the ramps and at 64K (every failing reading carries a canary move beyond the band between the two
processes); on the graph replay the same chains read 1.019-1.032 (a PASS at the 16K ramp, inside noise elsewhere). The 1.03 bar is therefore
NOT met on the in-session eager step and met within noise at the graph replay; under one profiler launch each the two main kernels run the
same number of cycles per 256-row tile at 16K (3660 vs 3649 clk), so the remaining step gap is a launch / clock term plus the softmax's
per-tile statistics fetch, which is the follow-up. At 2K / 4K FROST (either body) is at or ahead of FlashAttention-4's THD path.

### Selectable alternates (measured, not default)

- `warp_roles="16w_fa4"` (the softmax writes the dS halves and ships the exchange; warps 8-11 form the reduce group): measured SLOWER than
  the default `16w` at every cell, -5.1..-6.2 % on the eager step (8K-64K, both build orders at 16K / 32K) and
  -6.0..-16.5 % on the graph replay; it still beats the one-CTA body by +0.6..+2.5 %; dK / dV bitwise with the default. Kept for follow-up work.
- `dkv_accum="fp32_reduce"` (fp32 dK / dV accumulation across the q heads of a kv head, the fold launch removed): NEUTRAL on the step at every
  cell on both bodies (-0.6..+0.3 % vs the default pair at 16K-64K; -1.5..+0.1 % on the one-CTA body at 8K-32K), tighter dK / dV error on
  every validated cell (at 2K: dK 2.8e-03 vs 3.1e-03, dV 1.8e-02 vs 2.2e-02 max abs error against the fp64 reference), not bitwise
  reproducible across runs. An opt-in numerics attribute.
- `mask_form="predicated"` (the mask body only on tiles that can hold a masked cell): NEUTRAL, +0.2..+0.8 % at 16K / 32K and the 16K ramp,
  inside the band; bitwise-identical outputs with the default `fsel`.

Footnotes: (1) absolute times in every table are clock-capped lower bounds `[LB]`: the node ran under its power limit in every process, so
the sampled busy-median clock (1387-1830 MHz) is printed per row and the ratios inside one process / session are the figures of record;
(2) node class GB200, 152 SMs, SM clock locked at 1830 MHz; the pair kernel runs 76 clusters of two CTAs; (3) FlashAttention-4 at commit
98c1cee0; (4) the FROST kernel of record is the pair body's default rendering, PTX md5 4b3d0bbb, byte-identical in every measured tree
(this PR's head and the earlier tree) and pinned by the test module; (5) the measurement record (per-process attestation, clocks, control pairs, per-kernel
breakdowns) is retained internally.

## Restack onto develop

Clean (the branch is based on the current `develop`); head not re-measured after the prose-only final commit (the PTX md5 of every
rendering is pinned and unchanged).

## Review notes

- Rule S2: the tracker row is in the same commit as the engine row. Never a tolerance widened (the gate is the pre-existing grouped
  suite's fp64 reference, stated once). No diagnostic deleted: the default-off probes and the stamps lever stay typed and declined by name
  from `--validate`.
- black -l 160; SPDX header on every new file; every new test module carries `L0`.
- The guarded init of `dvk_stage_empty` (the fp32_reduce row has no user under the default rendering) stays guarded so the audited default
  rendering is byte-identical; an unguarded init is a follow-up.

## Open items

- The alternate role shape `16w_fa4` is kept selectable for follow-up work (a stamps layout and the fp32_reduce staging under it); its 7
  pair-skew rows are a critical GPU check for this PR (see the test census above).
- The direct entry `SdpaBwdDslSm100D128Cta2` (the pair body at any S, for probe drivers) and the `_stail` suffix of the body / module names
  (the body's TMEM map) are kept as they are; the dense MHA body's default-rendering md5 record and a build-time detector for the plan-time
  occupancy query are follow-ups.
- cc 10.3 is unmeasured (the one-CTA body serves it under `auto`); the 2K / 4K cells were measured as losses for the pair and are served by the one-CTA body (see the heuristic table).

detail.title: frost(sdpa bwd sm100 d128): cta_group::2 pair body for the grouped THD BF16 backward, selected by a per-S heuristic

files.patch:
@@ -638,9 +638,17 @@ def opaque_i32_zero():
 
 
 @cutlass.cute.jit
-def opaque_i32(value: cutlass.Int32) -> cutlass.Int32:
-    """Identity mov.b32 that pins a per-lane loop invariant in its register."""
-    return inline_ptx("mov.b32 $0, $1;", write_only_types=[cutlass.Int32], read_only_args=[value])
+def opaque_i32(value: cutlass.Int32, anchor=None) -> cutlass.Int32:
+    """Identity mov.b32 that pins a per-lane loop invariant in its register.
+
+    ``anchor`` (optional, append-only): a loop-VARIANT ``Int32`` (the q-tile counter) passed as an extra, unreferenced asm operand -- the
+    :func:`~cudnn.frost.tile_dsl.mma.desc_opaque` form for a 32-bit address term.  Without it an item-invariant SMEM address and every
+    ``base + vec`` add derived from it are hoisted by LLVM's LICM to the item loop's preheader and stay live across the whole tile body
+    (the sm100 d128 2-CTA softmax's 8 dS STS addresses: 8 registers, 4 of them spilled at the 144-register split, 2026-10-27); anchored,
+    the mov and the adds that depend on it sit inside the tile next to the STS that consumes them, so their live range is one tile.  The
+    default path (no anchor) emits exactly the asm it always did."""
+    args = [value] if cutlass.const_expr(anchor is None) else [value, anchor]
+    return inline_ptx("mov.b32 $0, $1;", write_only_types=[cutlass.Int32], read_only_args=args)
 
 
 @cutlass.cute.jit

@@ -15,6 +15,64 @@ class SdpaBwdDslSm100D128(SdpaBwdDsl):
     """Dense/THD MHA and BF16 GQA/MQA, with top-left causal or unmasked attention."""
 
     _NAME = "sdpa_bwd_sm100_d128"
+    # DIAGNOSTIC lever (default False = the shipped kernels, rendered PTX-identical; pinned by
+    # test_sdpa_bwd_d128_diag_dq_reduce_add_sm100.py): the store warp of the d128 accumulation bodies skips the fp32 dQ
+    # ``tma_reduce_add`` issues per q tile -- every barrier arrive / wait and the store-group waits stay, so the barrier
+    # table is unchanged -- and the OUTPUT IS WRONG BY DESIGN (dQ stays zero).  A timing-only ceiling for the L2 reduce-add
+    # term, set on the adapter INSTANCE before ``compile()`` by a probe driver; no graph path, knob or environment variable
+    # reaches it, and the compiled-plan cache keys the armed build apart.  Not a knob (it changes the function), never shipped armed.
+    diag_delete_dq_reduce_add: bool = False
+    # The per-S selector of the grouped THD route: which body serves a BF16 grouped THD request -- the one-CTA body
+    # (``bprop_d128_accum_grouped_f16``, implementation ``accumulation_grouped_thd``) or the cta_group::2 PAIR body
+    # (``bprop_d128_accum_grouped_2cta_stail_f16``, implementation ``accumulation_grouped_thd_2cta``; five launches either way).  A typed op-level
+    # field (``d128_grouped_2cta_contract.CTA_PAIR_MODES``): "auto" = THE default = the per-S rule -- the pair iff both declared S_q and S_kv >=
+    # ``CTA_PAIR_MIN_SEQ`` (8192: the smallest S where the pair body won the measured backward step on cc 10.0), cc in ``CTA_PAIR_CCS``, a cluster
+    # of two admitted by the device's occupancy query, and every support predicate of the pair body; else the one-CTA body.  "off" = the one-CTA
+    # body always; "on" = the pair body at any S, declining BY NAME when a predicate fails.  Resolved once in ``check_support``
+    # (``prepared_sm100_d128_grouped_2cta.resolve_cta_pair_body``) and recorded on the instance (``cta_pair_resolution``: the token
+    # ``pair=<mode>:<body>``).  No environment variable; set on the INSTANCE before ``check_support()``; the plan cache keys the two chains apart
+    # by body (the one-CTA rendering is untouched: its md5 pins hold).
+    cta_pair: str = "auto"

+"""Grouped THD d128 accumulation geometry on the cta_group::2 datapath (one cga2 PAIR per 256 kv rows).
+
+Layout-only record for ``kernels/sm100/bprop_d128_accum_grouped_2cta_f16.py``: every byte offset, TMEM column and
+register count derives from the geometry fields below and is re-derived by :func:`validate_config` at import.  The
+barrier table (``BAR_LAYOUT``) is FILLED BY the barrier audit; this module only reserves its bytes.
+
+Pair form (per CTA, KV-stationary: CTA ``rank`` owns kv rows ``[128 * rank, +128)`` of the pair's 256-row block and
+both CTAs walk the identical q range of ONE q head):
+
+* ``S^T = K Q^T`` and ``dP^T = V dO^T``: collective M = 256, A = own K / V (full d), B N-split = Q / dO rows
+  ``[64 * rank, +64)`` x 128 d (layout 1: today's two SW128 boxes [64 x 64]).
+* ``dV += P^T dO`` and ``dK += dS^T Q``: collective M = 256, TS A operand from the CTA's OWN TMEM image, B N-split
+  along d = dO / Q [128 q x 64 d] (layout 2: one SW128 box, MN-major -- the second Q / dO load).
+* ``dQ = dS K``: collective M = 128 (64 q rows per CTA), K-dim = the pair's 256 kv rows; A = dS [64 q x 256 kv] in
+  SMEM (own kv half by transposed STS, the peer's half by one DSMEM bulk copy), B N-split along d = K [256 kv x 64 d]
+  (the second K layout).  Its D image is the half-row atom: row m -> lane ``m % 64 + 64 * (n // 64)``, 64 columns.
+"""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Config:
+    # --- MMA geometry (per CTA; the collective M is M * CTA_MMA for the kv-stationary GEMMs) ---
+    M: int = 128  # kv rows per CTA
+    N: int = 128  # q rows per tile
+    D: int = 128  # d_qk == d_v
+    K_HW: int = 16  # bf16 / fp16 MMA K step on SM10x (one 32-B chunk; 32 is silently wrong)
+    BPE: int = 2
+    BPE_ACC: int = 4
+    CTA_MMA: int = 2  # cta_group::2
+    CGA_M: int = 2  # cluster (2, 1, 1)
+    CGA_N: int = 1
+    HEAD_BOX: int = 64  # bf16 elements per SW128 atom row = TMA box inner extent for Q / K / V / dO
+    DQ_BOX: int = 32  # fp32 elements per SW128 atom row = TMA reduce-add box inner extent
+    # --- ring depths ---
+    Q1_STAGES: int = 2  # S^T lookahead keeps today's two Q stages
+    # Q2 single-stage pays K2 (+32 KiB); 2 stages = 14 KiB over the cap. dK(t) frees it early.
+    Q2_STAGES: int = 1
+    DO_STAGES: int = 1
+    KV_STAGES: int = 1
+    SCHED_STAGES: int = 2
+    # --- warps / registers (16 warps; the follower's MMA warp is quiet) ---
+    THREADS: int = 512
+    SOFTMAX_WARPS: int = 8
+    EPILOGUE_WARPS: int = 4
+    SERVICE_WARPS: int = 4  # MMA 12, TMA-load 13, TMA-store 14, scheduler 15
+    SOFTMAX_REGS: int = 144
+    EPILOGUE_REGS: int = 144
+    SERVICE_REGS: int = 80
+    REGFILE: int = 65536
+    # --- TMEM ---
+    TMEM_COLS: int = 512  # one tcgen05.alloc.cta_group::2 of TMEM_COLS on BOTH CTAs; the same constant deallocates
+    # --- scaffold (declared budget: mbarriers + TMEM handle + CLC payload; the audit's rows must fit it) ---
+    SCAFFOLD_BYTES: int = 1024
+    TMEM_HANDLE_BYTES: int = 16
+    SCHED_PAYLOAD_BYTES: int = 64
+    # --- descriptor / swizzle facts ---
+    # layout implies DESC_VERSION 0 (roots < 256 KiB); 1 inherited from the baseline, unmeasured.
+    DESC_VERSION: int = 1
+    SWIZZLE_BYTES: int = 128
+    SWIZZLE_LAYOUT: int = 2
+    SOFTMAX_BARRIER: int = 1  # named barrier id; barrier 0 is the CTA sync
+
+    # --- derived: pair / split extents ---
+    @property
+    def PAIR_KV_ROWS(self):
+        return self.M * self.CTA_MMA  # 256: the scheduler's and THD's unit
+
+    @property
+    def Q_HALF(self):
+        return self.N // self.CTA_MMA  # 64 q rows per CTA (B N-split of S^T / dP^T; A M-split of dQ)
+
+    @property
+    def D_HALF(self):
+        return self.D // self.CTA_MMA  # 64 d per CTA (B N-split of dV / dK / dQ)
+
+    @property
+    def COLLECTIVE_M_KV(self):
+        return self.M * self.CTA_MMA  # 256 for S^T, dP^T, dV, dK
+
+    @property
+    def COLLECTIVE_M_Q(self):
+        return self.N  # 128 for dQ (64 rows per CTA, the half-row D image)
+
+    # --- derived: slab bytes (per stage) ---
+    @property
+    def Q1_BYTES(self):
+        return self.Q_HALF * self.D * self.BPE  # 16 KiB: [64 q x 128 d], two SW128 boxes [64 x HEAD_BOX]
+
+    @property
+    def Q2_BYTES(self):
+        return self.N * self.D_HALF * self.BPE  # 16 KiB: [128 q x 64 d], one SW128 box, MN-major B
+
+    @property
+    def DO1_BYTES(self):
+        return self.Q1_BYTES
+
+    @property
+    def DO2_BYTES(self):
+        return self.Q2_BYTES
+
+    @property
+    def K1_BYTES(self):
+        return self.M * self.D * self.BPE  # 32 KiB: own [128 kv x 128 d], A of S^T
+
+    @property
+    def K2_BYTES(self):
+        return self.PAIR_KV_ROWS * self.D_HALF * self.BPE  # 32 KiB: [256 kv x 64 d], B of dQ, one box of 256 rows
+
+    @property
+    def V_BYTES(self):
+        return self.K1_BYTES
+
+    @property
+    def DS_BYTES(self):
+        return self.Q_HALF * self.PAIR_KV_ROWS * self.BPE  # 32 KiB: [64 q x 256 kv] K-major, 4 K-chunks of 8 KiB
+
+    @property
+    def DS_HALF_BYTES(self):
+        return self.DS_BYTES // self.CTA_MMA  # 16 KiB: one CTA's 128 kv columns of the dQ A operand
+
+    @property
+    def XCHG_BYTES(self):
+        return self.DS_HALF_BYTES  # 16 KiB staging of the half the PEER needs: dS[peer's 64 q x own 128 kv]
+
+    @property
+    def DQ_SLICES(self):
+        return self.D // self.DQ_BOX  # 4 reduce-add slices per tile
+
+    @property
+    def DQ_SLICE_BYTES(self):
+        return self.Q_HALF * self.DQ_BOX * self.BPE_ACC  # 8 KiB: fp32 [64 q x 32 d]
+
+    @property
+    def DQ_STAGING_BYTES(self):
+        return self.DQ_SLICES * self.DQ_SLICE_BYTES  # 32 KiB: half of today's
+
+    @property
+    def DVK_STORE_BYTES(self):

+
+    @property
+    def DVK_STORE_HALF_BYTES(self):

+
+    @property
+    def STATS_BYTES(self):
+        return self.N * self.BPE_ACC  # 512 B: LSE for all 128 q of the tile (the D image spans N = 128 on both CTAs)
+
+    @property
+    def DELTA_BYTES(self):

+
+    # --- derived: byte offsets in DECLARATION order (every slab 1024-B aligned; STATS + DELTA share one 1 KiB) ---

+
+    @property

+
+    @property
+    def DO1(self):

+
+    @property
+    def DO2(self):
+        return self.DO1 + self.DO_STAGES * self.DO1_BYTES
+
+    @property
+    def K1(self):
+        return self.DO2 + self.DO_STAGES * self.DO2_BYTES
+
+    @property
+    def K2(self):
+        return self.K1 + self.KV_STAGES * self.K1_BYTES
+
+    @property
+    def V(self):
+        return self.K2 + self.KV_STAGES * self.K2_BYTES
+
+    @property
+    def DS(self):
+        return self.V + self.KV_STAGES * self.V_BYTES
+
+    @property
+    def XCHG(self):
+        return self.DS + self.DS_BYTES
+
+    @property

+
+    @property

+
+    @property
+    def STATS(self):
+        return self.XCHG + self.XCHG_BYTES
+
+    @property
+    def DELTA(self):
+        return self.STATS + self.STATS_BYTES
+
+    @property
+    def SLABS_END(self):
+        return self.DELTA + self.DELTA_BYTES
+
+    @property
+    def BARS(self):
+        return self.SLABS_END  # mbarrier block [BARS, TMEM_HANDLE); BAR_LAYOUT FILLED BY the barrier audit
+
+    @property
+    def SMEM_BYTES(self):
+        return self.SLABS_END + self.SCAFFOLD_BYTES
+
+    @property
+    def SCHED_PAYLOAD(self):
+        return self.SMEM_BYTES - self.SCHED_PAYLOAD_BYTES
+
+    @property
+    def TMEM_HANDLE(self):
+        return self.SCHED_PAYLOAD - self.TMEM_HANDLE_BYTES
+
+    @property
+    def BAR_BLOCK_BYTES(self):

+        return self.TMEM_HANDLE - self.BARS
+
+    # --- derived: rank-dependent alias geometry (CTA rank = position in the pair) ---

+    def ds_recv(self, rank):

+    @property

+def resolve_diag_2cta(name=None):
+    """The pair body's DIAGNOSTIC probe, typed: ``None`` -> no probe (THE default: the shipped body, PTX-identical); a name in
+    ``CFG.DIAG_2CTA_NAMES`` -> that probe (output WRONG BY DESIGN); anything else is a ``ValueError`` BY NAME."""
+    if name is None:
+        return None
+    if type(name) is not str or name not in CFG.DIAG_2CTA_NAMES:
+        raise ValueError(f"diag_2cta must be None or one of {CFG.DIAG_2CTA_NAMES}; got {name!r}")
+    return name

+def diag_2cta_code(name=None):
+    """The kernel's ``Constexpr[int]`` for a resolved probe name: 0 = no probe, else 1 + the name's index in ``CFG.DIAG_2CTA_NAMES``
+    (the kernel compares the code against the config-derived module constants, never a literal)."""
+    name = resolve_diag_2cta(name)
+    return 0 if name is None else 1 + CFG.DIAG_2CTA_NAMES.index(name)

+  packed P^T does not reuse): ``DQ_COL = S_COL + PACK_COLS``; [192, 256) is DEAD.  Two alias edges on the S tail: the WRITE edge dQ(t-1) <-

+  ``s_tail_empty``); ``dp_empty`` keeps its count and waiter, its arrive sits at the dS^T readout.

+def dbg_clk_records(n_batch, nheads, max_skv):
+    """CTA records per launch = the s_tail MAIN kernel's DECLARED grid (header section 14: ceil(max_skv / THD_UNIT_ROWS) pairs, at least one, x
+    CGA_M CTAs x nheads x n_batch).  Every CTA that RUNS writes its record at exit (a zero-trip CTA writes zeros + the magic); a cluster the CLC
+    scheduler cancelled never launches and leaves its two records unwritten (the region is not zeroed: the execute path allocates / converts
+    nothing), so a reader keeps the records whose first word is DBG_CLK.MAGIC (the decoder reports the never-launched count)."""
+    if any(type(n) is not int or n <= 0 for n in (n_batch, nheads, max_skv)):
+        raise ValueError("dbg_clk_records wants positive ints (n_batch, nheads, max_skv)")
+    return max((max_skv + CFG.THD_UNIT_ROWS - 1) // CFG.THD_UNIT_ROWS, 1) * CFG.CGA_M * nheads * n_batch
+

+def dbg_clk_bytes(n_batch, nheads, max_skv):
+    return dbg_clk_records(n_batch, nheads, max_skv) * DBG_CLK.BYTES

+"""Grouped THD d128 workspace on the cta_group::2 datapath: the grouped THD layout with NINE per-sequence tensor maps.
+
+Declaration-only arithmetic shared by the adapter and the traced host (no device reads).  The 2-CTA main kernel reads
+Q / dO through 64-row boxes (its N-split operands) AND 128-row boxes (its d-split operands) and reduces dQ through a
+64-row fp32 box, so the per-sequence map array holds ``MAPS_PER_SEQUENCE`` (9) descriptors instead of the 1-CTA path's 7;
+everything else (compact FP32 dQ / Delta, metadata, origins, native dK / dV partials) is the grouped THD contract.
+"""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Optional
+
+from .config_sm100_d128_accum_2cta import CFG
+from .d128_contract import WORKSPACE_ALIGNMENT, WORKSPACE_SLACK
+from .d128_grouped_contract import PARTIAL_ITEMSIZE
+from .d128_grouped_contract import validate_thd_bounds as _validate_grouped_thd_bounds
+from .d128_thd_contract import ORIGIN_PORTS
+
+ABI_VERSION = 1
+THD = "accumulation_grouped_thd_2cta"
+MAPS_PER_SEQUENCE = CFG.MAPS_PER_SEQUENCE
+UNIT_ROWS = CFG.THD_UNIT_ROWS  # 256 kv rows per CLC work item (one cga2 pair)
+
+# --- the per-S HEURISTIC: which body serves a BF16 grouped THD request (the adapter's typed op-level field ``cta_pair``) --------------------
+# One place for every number the selector reads (G10 config-as-truth; test_sdpa_bwd_d128_cta_pair_heuristic.py pins each).  The selector
+# itself (:func:`select_cta_pair`) is a pure function of plan facts: the device reads (cc, the occupancy query) are handed in by the
+# prepared module, so the rule is testable without a GPU and the probe runs only when the cheaper predicates passed.
+CTA_PAIR_MODES = ("auto", "off", "on")
+CTA_PAIR_MODE_DEFAULT = "auto"
+# The smallest S where the pair body won the in-session backward step on GB200 (cc 10.0) against the one-CTA body -- 8K +4.9 %, 16K +7.9 %,
+# 32K +8.5 %, 64K +8.8 % uniform, the varlen ramps +6.5 % (16K) / +8.3 % (32K) (2026-10-27; the rows of record in the PR); below it the pair
+# LOSES on the step (2K -3.9 %, 4K -3.5 %, measured) and the one-CTA body serves.  Lowered when a shorter S wins.
+# Both declared extents (S_q and S_kv: the batch's LONGEST sequence on each side) must reach it: the measured cells have them equal, so a
+# lopsided batch serves the measured-safe one-CTA body.
+CTA_PAIR_MIN_SEQ = 8192
+# The measured part.  SM103 (cc 10.3) is admitted by the pair body's own support check but has no measurement: it serves the one-CTA body
+# under ``auto`` and declines ``on`` by name until a row is measured there.
+CTA_PAIR_CCS = ((10, 0),)
+CTA_PAIR_CLUSTER = CFG.CGA_M  # the pair = one cluster of two CTAs; the device must admit at least one such cluster (the occupancy query)
+CTA_PAIR_BODY = "s_tail"  # the pair body's identity (its TMEM map: the dQ image in S^T's dead tail) = config_sm100_d128_accum_2cta_stail.CFG.TMEM_MAP
+PAIR_BODY = "2cta"
+ONE_CTA_BODY = "1cta"
+CTA_PAIR_PREDICATES = ("thd", "cc", "cluster", "seq")  # the names a decline / a fallback reason carries; ``seq`` under ``auto`` only
+
+
+class CtaPairDecline(ValueError):
+    """``cta_pair = "on"`` with a failing pair predicate: the text names the predicate and the value seen (the adapter's typed decline);
+    ``predicate`` = its ``CTA_PAIR_PREDICATES`` name (the dispatch appends the occupancy query's own failure text to a ``cluster`` decline)."""
+
+    def __init__(self, predicate, text):
+        super().__init__(text)
+        self.predicate = predicate
+
+
+def resolve_cta_pair(name=None):
+    """The adapter's ``cta_pair`` mode, typed: ``None`` -> ``CTA_PAIR_MODE_DEFAULT``; any value outside ``CTA_PAIR_MODES`` is a ``ValueError``
+    BY NAME (a selector outside its domain declines, never a silent default)."""
+    mode = CTA_PAIR_MODE_DEFAULT if name is None else name
+    if type(mode) is not str or mode not in CTA_PAIR_MODES:
+        raise ValueError(f"cta_pair must be one of {CTA_PAIR_MODES}; got {mode!r}")
+    return mode
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class CtaPairResolution:
+    """What the selector decided for one request: the mode it read, the body it chose, why, and the facts it read."""
+
+    mode: str
+    body: str  # PAIR_BODY | ONE_CTA_BODY
+    reason: str
+    s_q_max: int
+    s_kv_max: int
+    cc: Optional[tuple]
+    cluster_admitted: Optional[bool]  # None = the occupancy query was not consulted (off, or a cheaper predicate failed first)

+
+    @property
+    def token(self):
+        """The ``resolved_impl`` token a driver pins by value: ``pair=<mode>:<body>``."""
+        return f"pair={self.mode}:{self.body}"
+
+
+def _active_pairs(max_active_pairs):
+    value = max_active_pairs() if callable(max_active_pairs) else max_active_pairs
+    if type(value) is not int or value < 0:
+        raise ValueError(f"the occupancy query must yield a non-negative int of active clusters of {CTA_PAIR_CLUSTER}; got {value!r}")
+    return value
+

+def select_cta_pair(mode, *, thd, s_q_max, s_kv_max, cc, max_active_pairs):
+    """The per-S heuristic as a pure function of plan facts (no device reads here: the caller hands in Q's cc -- ``None`` off CUDA -- and the

+    probe kernel).

+    ``off`` -> the one-CTA body, nothing probed.  ``on`` -> the pair body at ANY S (the threshold is the heuristic's, not a support predicate);
+    a failing pair predicate (``thd`` / ``cc`` / ``cluster``) is a :class:`CtaPairDecline` naming it.  ``auto`` -> the pair body iff THD, cc in
+    ``CTA_PAIR_CCS``, both extents >= ``CTA_PAIR_MIN_SEQ`` and the device admits a cluster of ``CTA_PAIR_CLUSTER``; else the one-CTA body with

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Grouped THD d128 declarations on the cta_group::2 datapath: the grouped THD checks plus the pair envelope and nine maps.
+
+Also the grouped route's DISPATCH behind the typed adapter field ``SdpaBwdDslSm100D128.cta_pair`` (the per-S heuristic of
+``d128_grouped_2cta_contract``): :func:`resolve_cta_pair_body` reads the declaration and the device, :func:`check_support_selected` /
+:func:`compile_plan_selected` run the chosen body's own support check and compile (the one-CTA grouped THD body or this pair body), and
+:func:`cta_pair_resolution` hands the recorded decision to a driver (``token`` = ``pair=<mode>:<body>``).
+"""
+
+from dataclasses import replace
+from functools import partial
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+from cudnn.frost.compiled_cache import positional_entry
+from .config_sm100_d128_accum_2cta import resolve_diag_2cta
+from .config_sm100_d128_accum_2cta_stail import (
+    DBG_CLK,
+    dbg_clk_records,
+    dbg_clk_region_offset,
+    resolve_debug_clk,
+    resolve_mask_form,
+    resolve_warp_roles,
+    validate_fields_for_roles,
+)
+from .d128_grouped_2cta_contract import CTA_PAIR_BODY, CTA_PAIR_CLUSTER, ONE_CTA_BODY, PAIR_BODY, CtaPairDecline, resolve_cta_pair, select_cta_pair
+from .d128_grouped_2cta_contract import THD as IMPLEMENTATION
+from .d128_grouped_2cta_contract import WORKSPACE_SLACK, thd_workspace_layout, thd_workspace_offsets, validate_thd_bounds
+from .d128_grouped_contract import dsl_version_decline
+from .d128_thd_contract import KV_PORTS
+from .prepared import ROLES, BwdLaunchSpec, Operand
+from .prepared_sm100_d128_grouped import check_support as _check_support_grouped
+from .prepared_sm100_d128_grouped import dkv_accum
+from .prepared_sm100_d128_thd import THD_ATTRIBUTES, THD_ROLES, _GuardedEntry
+
+
+def cta_pair(api):
+    """The adapter record's per-S heuristic mode (``SdpaBwdDslSm100D128.cta_pair``: a ``CTA_PAIR_MODES`` name or ``None`` = "auto"), typed: a
+    ``ValueError`` names the field and the domain, prefixed with the engine name."""
+    try:
+        return resolve_cta_pair(getattr(api, "cta_pair", None))
+    except ValueError as error:
+        raise ValueError(f"{api._NAME}: {error}") from None
+
+
+def cta_pair_resolution(api):
+    """The :class:`~.d128_grouped_2cta_contract.CtaPairResolution` recorded by :func:`resolve_cta_pair_body` on this instance (``None`` before
+    ``check_support`` ran): the driver's ``pair=<mode>:<body>`` token, the facts read and the reason."""
+    return getattr(api, "_cta_pair", None)
+
+
+def _device_cc(api):
+    """The compute capability of Q's device, or ``None`` when it is not a CUDA device (the pair predicates then fall back / decline by name)."""
+    device = getattr(api.q_desc, "device", None)
+    if getattr(device, "type", None) != "cuda":
+        return None
+    from cudnn.frost.device import compute_capability, resolve_device
+
+    return tuple(compute_capability(resolve_device(device)))
+
+
+_MAX_ACTIVE_PAIRS = {}  # device index -> the occupancy query's answer; plan-time only, one probe compile per device per process
+_PROBE_FAILURES = {}  # device index -> the text of a query that failed (then the answer is 0 and the pair is not admitted)
+# What a failing query raises: the DSL absent (ImportError) or without the query (AttributeError), the driver's error (RuntimeError), a bad
+# device (ValueError).  Every one is the cluster predicate's typed decline, never an exception out of check_support.
+_PROBE_ERRORS = (ImportError, AttributeError, RuntimeError, ValueError)
+
+
+def _occupancy_query(index):
+    """The DSL's cluster occupancy query on device ``index`` (``cuOccupancyMaxActiveClusters`` on a probe kernel, ``cutlass.utils.HardwareInfo``):

+def _adapter_class():
+    """The 2-CTA adapter of THIS tree; a venv whose ``cudnn`` is another checkout has no such module (AGENTS.md: editable installs pin one checkout)."""
+    import importlib
+
+    import cudnn

+    try:

+def make_adapter_2cta(case, *, compile_plan=True, declaration=None, **fields):
+    """The suite's adapter construction (``d128_grouped_test_utils.make_adapter``) on the 2-CTA subclass (``cta_pair = "on"``: the pair body at
+    any S) plus any typed field set on the instance before ``check_support()`` (``diag_2cta`` / ``mask_form`` / ``warp_roles`` / ``dkv_accum`` /
+    ``debug_clk``); ``declaration`` selects the storage declaration helper (the grouped one by default; the MHA utils' for an MHA case)."""
+    from cudnn.api_base import TensorDesc
+
+    if declaration is None:
+        from d128_grouped_test_utils import declaration
+
+    cls = _adapter_class()
+    samples = {}
+    for role in ROLES:
+        shape, stride = declaration(case, role)
+        samples["sample_" + role] = TensorDesc(
+            dtype=torch.float32 if role == "stats" else case.dtype,
+            shape=shape,
+            stride=stride,
+            stride_order=tuple(sorted(range(4), key=lambda i: (stride[i], shape[i]))),
+            device=case.tensors["q"].device,
+            name=role,
+        )
+    thd = getattr(case, "thd", True)  # the MHA utils' case is always THD and carries no flag
+    api = cls(
+        **samples,
+        is_causal=case.causal,
+        scale_softmax=SCALE,
+        thd=thd,
+        max_total_seq_len_q=case.capacities[0] if thd else None,

+    )
+    for name, value in fields.items():
+        setattr(api, name, value)
+    if not compile_plan:
+        return api
+    assert api.check_support()
+    api.compile()
+    assert api._prepared.native is not None
+    assert api._prepared.artifact.implementation == _IMPLEMENTATION
+    return api

+def run_case_2cta(case, repeats=2, **fields):
+    """Execute the pair chain ``repeats`` times on a poisoned workspace and gate every output against the suite's fp64 reference."""
+    api = make_adapter_2cta(case, **fields)
+    workspace = make_workspace(api.scratch_workspace_bytes())
+    for _ in range(repeats):
+        poison(case, workspace)
+        api.execute(**adapter_arguments(case), workspace=workspace.tensor)

+        check_case(case, workspace)

+def _function_code(source, name, next_name):
+    """The CODE lines of ``def <name>`` up to ``def <next_name>`` with the docstring and the comment lines stripped (the punch lists repeat the
+    site names in prose; a source assertion reads the statements only)."""
+    start = source.index(f"def {name}(")

+    body = source[start:end]
+    doc = re.search(r'"""[\s\S]*?"""', body)

+def test_2cta_stail_tile_mask_predicate_is_exact_against_the_per_cell_mask():
+    """Lever the mask-form lever's interior-tile skip is bitwise ONLY if `tile_may_mask` is never FALSE on a tile that holds a masked cell (kernel header section 7).
+    The kernel's own plain-Python helper runs here on host ints against the per-cell mask _p_values applies -- keep column c of the lane with key k iff
+    c >= k under causal and c < (seq_q if k < seq_k else 0) -- over EVERY cell of every (pair, rank, q tile) the roles visit (lo = 2 pair under causal,
+    hi = ceil(seq_q / N)) on a grid of sequence lengths covering the THD edges (empty, shorter than one tile, partial tiles on both axes, exact
+    multiples, a dead second half, a dead pair past seq_k): sound (FALSE -> no masked cell) AND tight (TRUE -> a masked cell exists), both causal values."""
+    body = _body_module()
+    c = body.CFG
+    m_rows, n_cols, pair_rows = c.M, c.N, c.PAIR_KV_ROWS
+    lengths = (0, 1, 3, 65, 127, 128, 129, 200, 255, 256, 257, 300, 383, 384, 385, 511, 512, 513, 700, 1000, 1024)
+    rows = torch.arange(m_rows).view(-1, 1)
+    cols = torch.arange(n_cols).view(1, -1)
+    checked = {True: 0, False: 0}
+    for causal in (True, False):
+        for seq_q in lengths:
+            for seq_k in lengths:
+                hi_tile = (seq_q + n_cols - 1) // n_cols
+                for pair in range((seq_k + pair_rows - 1) // pair_rows + 1):  # + one dead pair past seq_k
+                    for rank in range(c.CGA_M):
+                        key = pair * pair_rows + rank * m_rows + rows
+                        hi = torch.where(key < seq_k, torch.tensor(seq_q), torch.tensor(0))
+                        for qtile in range(pair * c.Q_TILES_PER_PAIR if causal else 0, hi_tile):
+                            col = qtile * n_cols + cols
+                            masked = col >= hi
+                            if causal:
+                                masked = masked | (col < key)
+                            truth = bool(masked.any())
+                            assert body.tile_may_mask(pair, rank, qtile, seq_q, seq_k, causal) == truth, (causal, seq_q, seq_k, pair, rank, qtile, truth)
+                            checked[truth] += 1
+    assert checked[True] > 100 and checked[False] > 100, checked  # both verdicts exercised many times

+def _record_md5(path, body_token):
+    dsl, md5 = None, None
+    for ln in path.read_text().splitlines():
+        if ln.startswith("dsl="):
+            dsl = ln[len("dsl=") :].strip()
+        m = re.match(rf"{body_token} sm_100a default rc=0 ptx_md5=([0-9a-f]{{32}})", ln)
+        if m:
+            md5 = m.group(1)
+    return dsl, md5

+    from cudnn.frost.buffers import cutedsl_state

+* the DEFAULT rendering of both THD hosts equals the committed pre-lever record (``renderings/md5_d128_accum_thd_default_sm100a.txt``);

+    assert any("dkv_fp32 or i != DVK_STAGE_EMPTY_ROW" in ln for ln in init), "pair: the new row's init is guarded by the field (no user under the default)"
+
+
+# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ GPU rows
+def _make_1cta(case, *, compile_plan=True, **fields):
+    api = make_adapter(case, compile_plan=False)
+    for name, value in fields.items():
+        setattr(api, name, value)
+    if not compile_plan:
+        return api
+    assert api.check_support()
+    api.compile()
+    return api
+
+
+def _make_pair(case, *, compile_plan=True, **fields):
+    return make_adapter_2cta_stail(case, compile_plan=compile_plan, **fields)
+
+
+_BODIES = {"1cta": _make_1cta, "pair": _make_pair}
+_BODY_IDS = [pytest.param("1cta", id="1cta"), pytest.param("pair", id="pair")]
+
+
+def _run(case, body, repeats=2, **fields):
+    api = _BODIES[body](case, **fields)
+    workspace = make_workspace(api.scratch_workspace_bytes())
+    for _ in range(repeats):
+        poison(case, workspace)
+        api.execute(**adapter_arguments(case), workspace=workspace.tensor)
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        check_case(case, workspace)
+    return api, workspace
+
+
+def _grads(case):
+    return {role: case.tensors[role][0].detach().clone() for role in ("dq", "dk", "dv")}
+
+
+def _max_err(case, grads, role):
+    """(max abs error, max error in bf16 ulps at the reference magnitude) of ``role`` over the live rows against the fp64 oracle sequences."""
+    worst_abs, worst_ulp = 0.0, 0.0
+    lens = case.lens_q if role == "dq" else case.lens_kv
+    for i, (start, length) in enumerate(zip(case.origins[role], lens, strict=True)):
+        if not length:
+            continue
+        got, ref = grads[role][start : start + length].float().cpu(), case.sequences[i][role].float()
+        err = (got - ref).abs()
+        ulp = torch.ldexp(torch.ones_like(ref), torch.floor(torch.log2(ref.abs().clamp_min(2.0**-126))) - 7)  # one bf16 ulp at |ref|
+        worst_abs = max(worst_abs, float(err.max()))
+        worst_ulp = max(worst_ulp, float((err / ulp).max()))
+    return worst_abs, worst_ulp
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("body", _BODY_IDS)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "lq,lk,hq,hkv,causal,layout,offset_dtype,units,envelope",
+    [
+        pytest.param((129, 0, 127, 1), (65, 128, 0, 3), 4, 2, True, "TH1", torch.int32, "tokens", None, id="suite-degenerate-causal"),
+        pytest.param((129, 0, 127, 1), (65, 128, 0, 3), 6, 2, False, "HN", torch.int64, "elements", None, id="suite-degenerate-noncausal"),
+        pytest.param((0, 0), (0, 0), 3, 1, True, "HN", torch.int64, "elements", (128, 128), id="all-empty"),
+        pytest.param((300, 128, 1000), (2000, 700, 1000), 4, 2, True, "TH1", torch.int32, "tokens", None, id="zero-trip-mix"),
+        pytest.param((300, 300), (300, 300), 3, 1, True, "TH1", torch.int64, "elements", None, id="tail-300-gqa3"),
+        pytest.param((1024,), (1024,), 8, 1, True, "HN", torch.int32, "tokens", None, id="uniform-1024-gqa8"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_dkv_accum_fp32_matrix(body, lq, lk, hq, hkv, causal, layout, offset_dtype, units, envelope):
+    """The fp64-oracle ladder under ``fp32_reduce`` on both bodies: S % 256 != 0 tails, an all-empty batch, the zero-trip mix (items with N = 3, 1,
+    0 between live ones), n_q == 1 items, the 8-head group; every row at the suite's own gate (``_TOL`` / cosine), two executes per case."""
+    _require_accumulation()
+    case = make_case(
+        lq, lk, hq=hq, hkv=hkv, thd=True, dtype=torch.bfloat16, causal=causal, stats_layout=layout, offset_dtype=offset_dtype, units=units, envelope=envelope
+    )
+    api, _ = _run(case, body, **_FP32)
+    assert api._prepared.artifact.dkv_accum == "fp32_reduce"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("body", _BODY_IDS)
+def test_dkv_accum_fp32_n_q_one_more_items_than_sms(body):
+    """P14 row: n_q == 1 with more items than SMs (a CTA / pair claims a second CLC item: the two fp32 rounds per item re-arm the ring across
+    items), a half-dead last block and zero-trip blocks past seq_q."""
+    _require_accumulation()
+    sms = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).multi_processor_count
+    hq, b = 8, 2
+    skv = 256 * ((sms // (hq * b)) + 2) + 128
+    case = make_case((128, 64), (skv, skv - 256), hq=hq, hkv=1, dtype=torch.bfloat16, causal=True, stats_layout="TH1")
+    _run(case, body, **_FP32)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("body", _BODY_IDS)
+def test_dkv_accum_fp32_launch_census_is_four_with_no_host_work(body, monkeypatch):
+    """The fold launch is gone: four ``cudnn_kernel_`` launches (setup, delta_zero, MAIN, cast_dq) and no fold entry; the R9 gate (no allocation,
+    no host read, no Python tensor plumbing over three executes) holds as on the default chain."""
+    _require_accumulation()
+    import cutlass.cute as cute
+    from cudnn.sdpa.bwd import prepared
+
+    case = make_case((256, 256), (256, 256), hq=4, hkv=2, thd=True, dtype=torch.bfloat16, causal=True)
+    api, workspace = _run(case, body, repeats=1, **_FP32)
+    args = adapter_arguments(case)
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    sync_mode = torch.cuda.get_sync_debug_mode()
+    torch.cuda.set_sync_debug_mode("error")
+    try:
+        before = torch.cuda.memory_stats()["allocation.all.allocated"]
+
+        def forbidden(*a, **k):
+            raise AssertionError("the fp32_reduce chain used Python tensor plumbing, allocation, host read or compilation on the execute path")
+
+        with monkeypatch.context() as patch:
+            patch.setattr(cute, "compile", forbidden)
+            patch.setattr(prepared, "facts_of_roles", forbidden)
+            for name in ("empty", "empty_like", "zeros", "zeros_like", "ones", "full", "tensor"):
+                patch.setattr(torch, name, forbidden)
+            for name in ("view", "reshape", "as_strided", "permute", "transpose", "cpu", "item", "tolist"):
+                patch.setattr(torch.Tensor, name, forbidden)
+            for _ in range(3):
+                api.execute(**args, workspace=workspace.tensor)
+        assert torch.cuda.memory_stats()["allocation.all.allocated"] == before
+    finally:
+        torch.cuda.set_sync_debug_mode(sync_mode)
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    with torch.profiler.profile(activities=[torch.profiler.ProfilerActivity.CUDA]) as prof:
+        api.execute(**args, workspace=workspace.tensor)
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    kernels = [e.name for e in prof.events() if e.device_type == torch.autograd.DeviceType.CUDA and e.name.startswith("cudnn_kernel_")]
+    assert len(kernels) == 4, kernels
+    assert not any("dkv_reduce" in n for n in kernels), kernels
+    assert any("cast_dq_thd_d128_kernel" in n for n in kernels) and any("delta_zero_thd_d128_kernel" in n for n in kernels), kernels
+    check_case(case, workspace)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("body", _BODY_IDS)
+def test_dkv_accum_fp32_dq_bitwise_vs_default_on_one_kv_block_and_dk_dv_recorded(body):
+    """Twin vs the default on ONE dataset: dQ is untouched by the field, so where ONE kv block feeds every dQ element (S_kv <= 128 for the 1-CTA
+    body, <= 256 for the pair: one reduce-add contributor into the zero-filled fp32 image) it is BITWISE equal by construction; dK / dV are a
+    DIFFERENT rounding (fp32 group accumulate vs 8 bf16 partials summed in fp32) and are gated by the suite's own tolerance under each arm,
+    their max error against the fp64 oracle recorded side by side (never a new tolerance)."""
+    _require_accumulation()
+    lk = (128, 100) if body == "1cta" else (256, 200)
+    case = make_case((300, 200), lk, hq=8, hkv=2, thd=True, dtype=torch.bfloat16, causal=False, stats_layout="TH1")
+    grads = {}
+    for tag, fields in (("bf16_partials", {}), ("fp32_reduce", _FP32)):
+        _run(case, body, repeats=1, **fields)
+        grads[tag] = _grads(case)
+    assert torch.equal(grads["bf16_partials"]["dq"].view(torch.int16), grads["fp32_reduce"]["dq"].view(torch.int16)), "dQ must be bitwise: one kv block"
+    for role in ("dk", "dv"):
+        a, b = _max_err(case, grads["bf16_partials"], role), _max_err(case, grads["fp32_reduce"], role)
+        print(f"\n{body} {role}: max|err| bf16_partials {a[0]:.3e} ({a[1]:.2f} bf16 ulp) | fp32_reduce {b[0]:.3e} ({b[1]:.2f} bf16 ulp)")
+        for i, (start, length) in enumerate(zip(case.origins[role], case.lens_kv, strict=True)):
+            x, y = grads["bf16_partials"][role][start : start + length].float(), grads["fp32_reduce"][role][start : start + length].float()
+            torch.testing.assert_close(y, x, **_TOL[case.dtype], msg=lambda m: f"{role}/seq{i}: bf16_partials vs fp32_reduce: {m}")
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("body", _BODY_IDS)
+def test_dkv_accum_fp32_dq_at_the_gate_vs_default_over_many_kv_blocks(body):
+    """Several kv blocks per dQ element: dQ differs between the arms only by the fp32 add ORDER of the same reduce-adds (never bitwise, a tolerance
+    twin at the suite's gate after each arm passed the fp64 gate); dK / dV at the gate as well, the max errors recorded."""
+    _require_accumulation()
+    case = make_case((512, 768), (512, 768), hq=4, hkv=2, thd=True, dtype=torch.bfloat16, causal=True, stats_layout="TH1")
+    grads = {}
+    for tag, fields in (("bf16_partials", {}), ("fp32_reduce", _FP32)):
+        _run(case, body, repeats=1, **fields)
+        grads[tag] = _grads(case)
+    for role in ("dq", "dk", "dv"):
+        lens = case.lens_q if role == "dq" else case.lens_kv
+        a, b = _max_err(case, grads["bf16_partials"], role), _max_err(case, grads["fp32_reduce"], role)
+        print(f"\n{body} {role}: max|err| bf16_partials {a[0]:.3e} ({a[1]:.2f} bf16 ulp) | fp32_reduce {b[0]:.3e} ({b[1]:.2f} bf16 ulp)")
+        for i, (start, length) in enumerate(zip(case.origins[role], lens, strict=True)):
+            x, y = grads["bf16_partials"][role][start : start + length].float(), grads["fp32_reduce"][role][start : start + length].float()
+            torch.testing.assert_close(y, x, **_TOL[case.dtype], msg=lambda m: f"{role}/seq{i}: bf16_partials vs fp32_reduce: {m}")
+
+
+def _make_mha_1cta(case, **fields):
+    """The MHA THD suite's adapter construction (d128_thd_test_utils.make_adapter) with the typed fields set BEFORE check_support()."""
+    from cudnn.api_base import TensorDesc
+    from cudnn.sdpa.bwd.api_dsl_sm100_d128 import SdpaBwdDslSm100D128
+    from d128_thd_test_utils import ROLES as MHA_ROLES
+    from d128_thd_test_utils import SCALE as MHA_SCALE
+    from d128_thd_test_utils import declaration as mha_declaration
+
+    samples = {}
+    for role in MHA_ROLES:
+        shape, stride = mha_declaration(case, role)
+        samples["sample_" + role] = TensorDesc(
+            dtype=torch.float32 if role == "stats" else case.dtype,
+            shape=shape,
+            stride=stride,
+            stride_order=tuple(sorted(range(4), key=lambda i: (stride[i], shape[i]))),
+            device=case.tensors["q"].device,
+            name=role,
+        )
+    api = SdpaBwdDslSm100D128(
+        **samples,
+        is_causal=case.causal,
+        scale_softmax=MHA_SCALE,
+        thd=True,
+        max_total_seq_len_q=case.capacities[0],
+        max_total_seq_len_kv=case.capacities[1],
+        thd_stats_token_major=case.stats_layout == "TH1",
+        thd_stats_head_stride=case.head_pitch if case.stats_layout == "HN" else None,
+        thd_ragged_offsets=case.offset_declarations,
+    )
+    for name, value in fields.items():
+        setattr(api, name, value)
+    return api
+
+
+def test_dkv_accum_fp32_declines_dense_grouped_and_mha_by_name():
+    """The fp32 form is served on the THD grouped chain only: the dense grouped route and the MHA routes decline it BY NAME in check_support,
+    before any compile; a value outside the vocabulary is a ValueError there."""
+    from d128_thd_test_utils import make_case as make_mha_case
+
+    _require_accumulation()
+    dense = make_case((256, 256), (256, 256), hq=4, hkv=2, thd=False)
+    with pytest.raises(NotImplementedError, match="fp32_reduce"):
+        _make_1cta(dense, compile_plan=False, **_FP32).check_support()
+    with pytest.raises(NotImplementedError, match="fp32_reduce"):
+        _make_mha_1cta(make_mha_case((129, 3), (129, 3), heads=2), **_FP32).check_support()
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="dkv_accum"):
+        _make_1cta(make_case((129, 3), (65, 3), hq=4, hkv=2, thd=True), compile_plan=False, dkv_accum="fp32").check_support()

+    from cudnn.sdpa.bwd.prepared_sm100_d128_grouped_2cta import debug_clk, diag_2cta
+
+    assert base.resolve_diag_2cta(None) is None and [base.resolve_diag_2cta(p) for p in _PROBES] == list(_PROBES)
+    assert [base.diag_2cta_code(p) for p in _PROBES] == [1, 2, 3, 4] and base.diag_2cta_code(None) == 0
+    for bad in ("dp_empty_wait_off", "ds_gates_off", "bogus", "", 1):
+        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="diag_2cta must be None or one of"):
+            base.resolve_diag_2cta(bad)
+    assert diag_2cta(SimpleNamespace(_NAME="x")) is None and diag_2cta(SimpleNamespace(_NAME="x", diag_2cta="exchange_off")) == "exchange_off"
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="sdpa_bwd_sm100_d128: diag_2cta must be None or one of"):
+        diag_2cta(SimpleNamespace(_NAME="sdpa_bwd_sm100_d128", diag_2cta="dp_empty_wait_off"))
+    # the STAMPS lever: a typed bool, False by default; the reader prefixes the engine name
+    assert cfgmod.resolve_debug_clk(None) is False and cfgmod.resolve_debug_clk(True) is True and cfgmod.resolve_debug_clk(False) is False
+    assert debug_clk(SimpleNamespace(_NAME="x")) is False and debug_clk(SimpleNamespace(_NAME="sdpa_bwd_sm100_d128", debug_clk=True)) is True
+    for bad_flag in (1, "True", 0, ""):
+        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="must be a bool"):
+            cfgmod.resolve_debug_clk(bad_flag)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="sdpa_bwd_sm100_d128: debug_clk must be a bool"):
+        debug_clk(SimpleNamespace(_NAME="sdpa_bwd_sm100_d128", debug_clk=1))
+    assert SdpaBwdDslSm100D128.debug_clk is False and SdpaBwdDslSm100D128.diag_2cta is None  # the record defaults
+    for pruned in ("tmem_map", "pair_mma_order", "dq_route_pair", "tma_load_form", "store_wait_form", "reg_split", "datapath_2cta"):
+        assert not hasattr(SdpaBwdDslSm100D128, pruned), pruned
+    for pruned in ("PAIR_MMA_ORDERS", "DQ_ROUTES_PAIR", "TMA_LOAD_FORMS", "STORE_WAIT_FORMS", "REG_SPLITS", "REG_SPLIT_NAMES"):
+        assert not hasattr(cfgmod.CFG, pruned) and not hasattr(base.CFG, pruned), pruned
+
+
+def test_2cta_stail_mask_form_is_typed():
+    """``mask_form`` is a typed field: ``None`` = "fsel" (the shipped rendering); "predicated" and the DIAGNOSTIC "diag_mask_off" are the other two
+    values; anything else declines BY NAME; the kernel's constants are the config's code space (config = truth); the adapter reader prefixes the
+    engine name; the record default is None."""
+    from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+    from cudnn.sdpa.bwd import config_sm100_d128_accum_2cta_stail as cfgmod
+    from cudnn.sdpa.bwd.api_dsl_sm100_d128 import SdpaBwdDslSm100D128
+    from cudnn.sdpa.bwd.prepared_sm100_d128_grouped_2cta import mask_form
+
+    c = cfgmod.CFG
+    assert c.MASK_FORMS == _MASK_FORMS and c.MASK_FORM_DEFAULT == "fsel" and c.MASK_FORM_DIAGNOSTIC == "diag_mask_off"
+    assert cfgmod.MASK_FORM_CODES == {"fsel": 0, "predicated": 1, "diag_mask_off": 2} and tuple(cfgmod.MASK_FORM_CODES) == c.MASK_FORMS
+    assert (c.MASK_SELECTS_PER_LANE_PER_TILE, c.MASK_WORDS_PER_LANE_PER_TILE, c.MASK_WORD_COLS) == (64, 2, 32)
+    assert cfgmod.resolve_mask_form(None) == "fsel"
+    for form, code in (("fsel", 0), ("predicated", 1), ("diag_mask_off", 2)):
+        assert cfgmod.resolve_mask_form(form) == form and cfgmod.mask_form_code(form) == code
+    assert cfgmod.mask_form_code(None) == 0
+    for bad_form in ("bogus", "", "FSEL", 1):
+        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="mask_form must be one of"):
+            cfgmod.resolve_mask_form(bad_form)
+        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="mask_form must be one of"):
+            cfgmod.mask_form_code(bad_form)
+    assert mask_form(SimpleNamespace(_NAME="sdpa_bwd_sm100_d128", mask_form="predicated")) == "predicated"
+    assert mask_form(SimpleNamespace(_NAME="sdpa_bwd_sm100_d128", mask_form="diag_mask_off")) == "diag_mask_off"
+    assert mask_form(SimpleNamespace(_NAME="x")) == "fsel"
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="sdpa_bwd_sm100_d128: mask_form must be one of"):
+        mask_form(SimpleNamespace(_NAME="sdpa_bwd_sm100_d128", mask_form="pred"))
+    assert SdpaBwdDslSm100D128.mask_form is None  # the record default: today's rendering
+    body = _body_module()
+    assert (body.MASK_FORM_FSEL, body.MASK_FORM_PREDICATED, body.MASK_FORM_DIAG_OFF) == tuple(cfgmod.MASK_FORM_CODES[f] for f in _MASK_FORMS)
+
+
+def test_2cta_stail_tile_mask_predicate_is_exact_against_the_per_cell_mask():
+    """Lever the mask-form lever's interior-tile skip is bitwise ONLY if `tile_may_mask` is never FALSE on a tile that holds a masked cell (kernel header section 7).
+    The kernel's own plain-Python helper runs here on host ints against the per-cell mask _p_values applies -- keep column c of the lane with key k iff
+    c >= k under causal and c < (seq_q if k < seq_k else 0) -- over EVERY cell of every (pair, rank, q tile) the roles visit (lo = 2 pair under causal,
+    hi = ceil(seq_q / N)) on a grid of sequence lengths covering the THD edges (empty, shorter than one tile, partial tiles on both axes, exact
+    multiples, a dead second half, a dead pair past seq_k): sound (FALSE -> no masked cell) AND tight (TRUE -> a masked cell exists), both causal values."""
+    body = _body_module()
+    c = body.CFG
+    m_rows, n_cols, pair_rows = c.M, c.N, c.PAIR_KV_ROWS
+    lengths = (0, 1, 3, 65, 127, 128, 129, 200, 255, 256, 257, 300, 383, 384, 385, 511, 512, 513, 700, 1000, 1024)
+    rows = torch.arange(m_rows).view(-1, 1)
+    cols = torch.arange(n_cols).view(1, -1)
+    checked = {True: 0, False: 0}
+    for causal in (True, False):
+        for seq_q in lengths:
+            for seq_k in lengths:
+                hi_tile = (seq_q + n_cols - 1) // n_cols
+                for pair in range((seq_k + pair_rows - 1) // pair_rows + 1):  # + one dead pair past seq_k
+                    for rank in range(c.CGA_M):
+                        key = pair * pair_rows + rank * m_rows + rows
+                        hi = torch.where(key < seq_k, torch.tensor(seq_q), torch.tensor(0))
+                        for qtile in range(pair * c.Q_TILES_PER_PAIR if causal else 0, hi_tile):
+                            col = qtile * n_cols + cols
+                            masked = col >= hi
+                            if causal:
+                                masked = masked | (col < key)
+                            truth = bool(masked.any())
+                            assert body.tile_may_mask(pair, rank, qtile, seq_q, seq_k, causal) == truth, (causal, seq_q, seq_k, pair, rank, qtile, truth)
+                            checked[truth] += 1
+    assert checked[True] > 100 and checked[False] > 100, checked  # both verdicts exercised many times
+
+
+def _render(tmp_path, form_kw, extra_census=None):
+    """Host trace-compile of the 2-CTA chain for sm_100a in a fresh process with THIS module's census (plus ``extra_census`` rows) -> (PTX md5,
+    census, setmaxnreg pairs)."""
+    return render_2cta(tmp_path, form_kw, dict(_CENSUS, **(extra_census or {})))
+
+
+def _record_md5(path, body_token):
+    dsl, md5 = None, None
+    for ln in path.read_text().splitlines():
+        if ln.startswith("dsl="):
+            dsl = ln[len("dsl=") :].strip()
+        m = re.match(rf"{body_token} sm_100a default rc=0 ptx_md5=([0-9a-f]{{32}})", ln)
+        if m:
+            md5 = m.group(1)
+    return dsl, md5
+
+
+def test_2cta_stail_host_renders_for_sm_100a_and_matches_its_record(tmp_path):
+    """Host trace-compile of the chain with every field unset (no device): the body's PTX census is the header's (sections 5 / 11), no local
+    memory, no nanosleep, the 144 / 144 / 80 register split; the md5 matches the committed record at this geometry (skips, never widens, on
+    another DSL build)."""
+    from cudnn.frost.buffers import cutedsl_state
+
+    md5, census, regs = _render(tmp_path, {})
+    print(f"\n2-CTA s_tail sm_100a: PTX md5 {md5} census {census} setmaxnreg {regs}")
+    assert census == _EXPECTED, census
+    assert sorted(regs) == _setmaxnreg_of(), regs
+    assert _RECORD.is_file(), _RECORD
+    dsl, want = _record_md5(_RECORD, "d128_accum_grouped_2cta_stail")
+    assert dsl and want, (dsl, want)
+    _installed, version = cutedsl_state()
+    have = " ".join(version) if version else None
+    if have != dsl:
+        pytest.skip(f"the md5 record was rendered with {dsl}; installed {have}: PTX text differs by DSL build, re-render the record")
+    assert md5 == want, f"PTX md5 {md5} != the record's {want} -- the s_tail rendering changed"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("probe", _PROBES)
+def test_2cta_stail_host_renders_probes_for_sm_100a(tmp_path, probe):
+    """``diag_2cta = <probe>`` removes exactly its own ISSUE (dq_reduce_add_off: the four reduce-adds), TRANSFER (exchange_off: the one bulk copy +
+    its two mapa, the arm keeping its count with a 0-byte operand) or BYTES (stats_one_chunk: 28 of the 32 stats LDS.128; sdq_sts_off: the 24
+    sDQ slice STS + their 3 proxy fences) and nothing else -- every arrive and wait site, every bar.warp.sync and tcgen05.fence stays (the barrier
+    table is identical: the purity census); the probe renders a different md5 from the default."""
+    from cudnn.sdpa.bwd import config_sm100_d128_accum_2cta as base
+    from cudnn.sdpa.bwd import config_sm100_d128_accum_2cta_stail as cfgmod
+
+    md5_d, census_d, _ = _render(tmp_path, {}, _ROUTE_CENSUS)
+    assert census_d == dict(_EXPECTED, sts_dq_v2_b64=24, fence_proxy_async=15, bulk_commit_group=5), census_d
+    md5, census, _ = _render(tmp_path, {"diag_2cta": probe}, _ROUTE_CENSUS)
+    print(f"\n2-CTA s_tail sm_100a PTX census ({probe}): md5 {md5} {census}")
+    assert census == dict(census_d, **_probe_census_delta(probe, cfgmod.CFG, census_d)), (probe, census)
+    assert md5 != md5_d, f"{probe} must render different PTX from the default"
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="diag_2cta must be None or one of"):  # a probe of an earlier pair body is outside the domain: never rendered
+        base.resolve_diag_2cta("ds_gates_off")
+
+
+def test_2cta_stail_probes_resolve_the_same_way_under_fp32_dkv_accum(tmp_path):
+    """fp32_reduce x the probes: the fp32 dK / dV staging of ``dkv_accum = "fp32_reduce"`` (header section 11) lives in the dS slab halves (own +
+    recv) and XCHG, slots that rest on the three dS gates -- a probe that skipped those gates is outside the domain under BOTH field values
+    (asserted here at compile_host, the chain's entry, exactly as the probe arms reach it).  ``exchange_off`` x ``fp32_reduce`` renders like every
+    other probe: OUTPUT WRONG BY DESIGN (dQ: the recv half is never written), a different md5 from the fp32 default under the SAME mbarrier
+    arrive / wait census with exchange_off's own transfer delta only (the arm's bytes go to 0, the one bulk copy + its two mapa gone; no barrier
+    row moves; nothing asynchronous writes the recv-half slots under the probe).  The combination is reachable through the typed fields only;
+    the ``--validate`` refusal is per probe name."""
+    from cudnn.sdpa.bwd import config_sm100_d128_accum_2cta_stail as cfgmod
+    from cudnn.sdpa.bwd.kernels.sm100.prepared_d128_grouped_2cta_host import compile_host
+
+    for accum in (None, "fp32_reduce"):
+        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="diag_2cta must be None or one of"):
+            compile_host((2, 8, 2, True), (None,) * 9, (None,) * 9, None, True, 100, diag_2cta="ds_gates_off", dkv_accum=accum)
+    md5_fp32, census_fp32, _ = _render(tmp_path, {"dkv_accum": "fp32_reduce"}, _ROUTE_CENSUS)
+    md5, census, _ = _render(tmp_path, {"dkv_accum": "fp32_reduce", "diag_2cta": "exchange_off"}, _ROUTE_CENSUS)
+    print(f"\n2-CTA s_tail sm_100a PTX census (fp32_reduce x exchange_off): md5 {md5} {census}")
+    assert md5 != md5_fp32, "exchange_off x fp32_reduce must render different PTX from the fp32 default"
+    assert census == dict(census_fp32, **_probe_census_delta("exchange_off", cfgmod.CFG, census_fp32)), (census_fp32, census)
+
+
+def test_2cta_stail_fields_under_16w_fa4_decline_or_resite_by_name(tmp_path):
+    """The alternate role shape x the other fields: under ``warp_roles = "16w_fa4"`` the STAMPS lever ``debug_clk`` and ``dkv_accum = "fp32_reduce"``
+    DECLINE BY NAME at compile_host (the record layout names the 16w roles' waits; the fp32 staging rounds live in the 16w epilogue loop), and the
+    fp32 row ``dvk_stage_empty`` is UNSERVED there (absent from ``BAR_LAYOUT_XFA4`` / ``BarsXFA4``); ``exchange_off`` is sited at the softmax's arm +
+    ship under 16w_fa4 and renders with its own transfer delta only (the one bulk copy + its two mapa gone, the arm's bytes 0; every arrive / wait
+    stays), a different md5 from the 16w_fa4 default; both fields pass under the default shape (16w)."""
+    from cudnn.sdpa.bwd import config_sm100_d128_accum_2cta_stail as cfgmod
+    from cudnn.sdpa.bwd.kernels.sm100.prepared_d128_grouped_2cta_host import compile_host
+
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="debug_clk is not defined under warp_roles '16w_fa4'"):
+        compile_host((2, 8, 2, True), (None,) * 9, (None,) * 9, None, True, 100, warp_roles="16w_fa4", debug_clk=True)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="dkv_accum 'fp32_reduce' is not built under warp_roles '16w_fa4'"):
+        compile_host((2, 8, 2, True), (None,) * 9, (None,) * 9, None, True, 100, warp_roles="16w_fa4", dkv_accum="fp32_reduce")
+    assert cfgmod.validate_fields_for_roles("16w", None, debug_clk=True, dkv_accum="fp32_reduce") == "16w"
+    assert cfgmod.UNSERVED_BARRIERS_XFA4 == ("dvk_stage_empty",) and "dvk_stage_empty" not in {row[0] for row in cfgmod.BAR_LAYOUT_XFA4}
+    assert "dvk_stage_empty" in {row[0] for row in cfgmod.BAR_LAYOUT} and "dvk_stage_empty" not in _body_module().BarsXFA4._fields
+    md5_fa4, census_fa4, _ = _render(tmp_path, {"warp_roles": "16w_fa4"}, _ROUTE_CENSUS)
+    md5, census, _ = _render(tmp_path, {"warp_roles": "16w_fa4", "diag_2cta": "exchange_off"}, _ROUTE_CENSUS)
+    print(f"\n2-CTA s_tail sm_100a PTX census (16w_fa4 x exchange_off): md5 {md5} {census}")
+    assert md5 != md5_fa4, "exchange_off x 16w_fa4 must render different PTX from the 16w_fa4 default"
+    assert census == dict(census_fa4, **_probe_census_delta("exchange_off", cfgmod.CFG, census_fa4)), (census_fa4, census)
+
+
+def test_2cta_stail_host_renders_debug_clk_for_sm_100a(tmp_path):
+    """``debug_clk = True`` (the STAMPS lever, header section 11) renders the %clock64 brackets (and the two %globaltimer body stamps) on top of the
+    SAME barrier census: 40 arrive / 68 try_wait / 11 expect_tx / 67 bar.warp.sync / 32 tcgen05.fence sites, the ship, the reduce-adds, the STS,
+    no local memory, no nanosleep, the default register split -- under a different md5; the default (False) rendering is the record's."""
+    md5_on, census_on, regs_on = _render(tmp_path, {"debug_clk": True})
+    print(f"\n2-CTA s_tail debug_clk sm_100a: PTX md5 {md5_on} census {census_on} setmaxnreg {regs_on}")
+    # the lever adds the clock reads and the record dump's SMEM reads (the 100-word copy at exit vectorizes into 16-B loads); nothing else moves
+    assert census_on["clock64"] > 0 and census_on["lds_v4_b32"] >= _EXPECTED["lds_v4_b32"], census_on
+    assert census_on == dict(_EXPECTED, clock64=census_on["clock64"], lds_v4_b32=census_on["lds_v4_b32"]), census_on
+    assert sorted(regs_on) == _setmaxnreg_of(), regs_on
+    md5_off, census_off, _ = _render(tmp_path, {"debug_clk": False})
+    assert census_off == _EXPECTED and md5_off != md5_on, "debug_clk=False is the default rendering; True must differ (the clock reads)"
+    dsl, want = _record_md5(_RECORD, "d128_accum_grouped_2cta_stail")
+    assert md5_off == want or dsl, "debug_clk=False renders the record's md5 (a DSL build difference is a skip, not a widen)"
